description: This file defines the VhostDeviceVsock class, which manages the creation and control of a virtual socket device for Vhost in the Cuttlefish project. It includes methods for generating commands, checking availability, and configuration setup, as well as defining a dependency injection component.

classes.name: VhostDeviceVsock
classes.description: A class that manages the lifecycle and configuration of a Vhost device socket for virtualization in Cuttlefish.

methods.name: VhostDeviceVsock
methods.description: Constructor initializing the VhostDeviceVsock with dependencies and configuration.

methods.name: Commands
methods.description: Generates a list of commands to start the Vhost device socket, including environment variables and parameters.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of the VhostDeviceVsock.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Checks if the Vhost device socket is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: WaitForAvailability
methods.description: Waits until the Vhost socket is available, with a timeout.
